name: Layout Dashboard Icon
description: Icon for dashboard and layout views with an animated fill-swap effect on hover

variations.name: default
variations.description: On hover, the two filled panels swap to the opposite two panels

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke and fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Controls the fill-swap animation. Manage this state in the parent and pass it down — e.g. via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave on a button wrapper.

variations.name: swap
variations.description: On hover, the filled boxes physically morph and travel to take the position and shape of the empty boxes

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke and fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Controls the morph animation. Manage this state in the parent and pass it down — e.g. via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave on a button wrapper.
